newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Two Russian military personnel shot in Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: Two Russian military personnel shot in Tajikistan.

text.p: The bodies of two Russian military medical personnel shot dead in the Tajik capital Dushanbe were found in the street on Friday, Russian defence sources said.

It was the fourth reported attack on Russian servicemen in the former Soviet republic in under a week. No one has claimed responsibility for shootings, which have been widely blamed on Islamist opposition fighters.

Major Alexander Maystrenko and nurse Fatima Azizova, who both worked at the 201st Motorised Infantry Division's hospital in Dushanbe, were shot in the head with a Makarov pistol on Thursday night, the sources told Reuters.
Dozens of Russian servicemen have been killed or injured in the remote, mountainous republic where they carry out peacekeeping duties and guard the border with Afghanistan.

A Russian sergeant with the division was shot dead on Tuesday or Wednesday. Five servicemen were badly wounded when their vehicle was attacked with a rocket-propelled grenade and automatic weapons on Saturday and a soldier was wounded by gunmen on Tuesday.
Tajikistan's secular government and the Islamist opposition signed an accord in Moscow last month aimed at ending four years of civil war. A ceasefire appears to be holding.
